names: Mission Bay South Block 34 (unnamed UCSF building)
summary: This record's geometry is the south of two real, previously untracked UCSF buildings between 3rd and Illinois Streets down to Mariposa Street; that location -- the corner of 3rd, Mariposa and Illinois -- matches UCSF's own Bayfront Medical Building (520 Illinois St), a five-story, ~182,800-sq-ft clinical building (Stantec architect, Clark Construction general contractor) built alongside a new Illinois Street parking garage under UCSF's 'Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage' project, with construction starting October 2021 and the clinic opening in August 2024.

milestones.text: UC Regents' Committee on Finance and Capital Strategies (May 19-21, 2020 meeting) approves preliminary-plans/working-drawings funding and scope for the Block 34 parking garage, and preliminary-plans funding for the Block 34 clinical building

Construction begins on the Illinois Street Garage portion of the Block 34 project specifically (500 spaces, nine levels), per Clark Construction's own press release: "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021" -- distinct from the clinical building's own Sept/Oct 2021 groundbreaking
Construction begins on the Block 34 clinical building

UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building (520 Illinois St) opens -- probable identity of this record's building, inferred from its position at the 3rd/Mariposa/Illinois corner this project's clinical building occupies (see open_questions). The adjoining nine-level, 500-space Illinois Street Garage came online separately in 2023.

open_questions: This record's own geometry file states the building's name/address/operator are not confirmed by any source checked in the geometry-correction pass. This research pass found a strong but not fully confirmed candidate: UCSF's Bayfront Medical Building (520 Illinois St), the clinical half of the 'Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage' project, whose own CEQA filing places it south of the Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision (this project's mission_bay_490_illinois record) and at the corner of 3rd and Mariposa -- matching this record's own notes exactly (south building, extending to Mariposa St). No source directly ties an address to this record's own OCII plan-block-34 parcel number, so the identification is geographic inference from UCSF's own project descriptions, not confirmed by an address-to-parcel source.

2026-09-22 pass: Commercial Property Executive's Aug 2024 article states the building opened Aug 27, 2024 and the garage "came online" in 2023 (no specific day found for the garage); this resolves the prior Aug 23 vs 27 ambiguity in favor of Aug 27, though the exact day for the garage's own opening is still not pinned down.

A second 2026-09-22 pass reversed the CPE-based read above: Clark Construction's own press release (the general contractor, a more authoritative account than a trade article's paraphrase) explicitly states "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021" -- i.e. before, not after, the clinical building's own Sept/Oct 2021 groundbreaking. Added as a real milestone. The garage's own exact opening day (commonly reported as May 15, 2023) was not found as a directly quotable primary source in this pass -- UCSF's own project page states it but has repeatedly blocked automated access (403) by every method tried -- so only the year (2023) is used above, not the specific day.

Total project cost is reported elsewhere as approximately $335.8 million for the combined clinical building and garage; not broken out per building and not independently verified against a primary UCSF or Regents document in this pass, so left out of costs.
